neighbours.label: the verbalising suffix token '-ize / -ise / -ization' (also Spanish '-ización', Korean '화', Chinese '化')
fire: Her thesis examines the professionalization of social work after the war.
The appendix explains the romanization used for Korean names.
The city wants to modernize its tram lines before the games.
The charity is trying to professionalise its volunteer training.
Kant asks whether you could universalize the rule you act on.
The museum will digitalize its collection of old maps.
The report describes the westernization of local diets.
The union pushed to formalize the agreement in writing.
quiet: Her thesis examines the professional history of social work after the war.

notes: Early layer, gate-closed echo regime, max only 1.80 and flagged broad (1.2% of tokens reach 0.1 of max). Probes: 'ization' 0.76-0.80, 'ize' 0.68, 'ise' 0.92, 'ización' 0.41, '现代化' 0.42; controls 0.08-0.11. The - pole is the specific word 'normalize/normalization'.
